de.abas.jfop.base.buffer

Interface WriteableBuffer

  • All Superinterfaces:
    BaseReadableBuffer, Buffer, ReadableBuffer
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    AddBuffer, CharactBarBuffer, GlobalTextBuffer, LoadBuffer, LockableBuffer, ParentScreenBuffer, PrintBuffer, ScreenBuffer, ScreenEnabledBuffer, SelectableBuffer, SelectBarBuffer, SelectBuffer, TableEnabledBuffer, TableModifiableBuffer, TextBuffer, UserTextBuffer

    public interface WriteableBuffer
extends ReadableBuffer
    This interface describes a writeable FO buffer's capabilities.

      • getWriter

        Writer getWriter(String field)
          throws FOPException
        Offers the possibility to write a free text field (type TN) with a Writer. The field will be written when the special Writer is closed. That is the field still has to be available when close is called. Therefore do not unload the record during the write. Technically all data will be written to a local temporary S3 encoded file. On close the field will be filled with the file's contents.

        This method does not work in a remote context!

        Parameters:
        field - The free text field.
        Returns:
        The writer instance.
        Throws:
        FOPException - If an error occurs.
